_comment: Inputs for build.py (graphite style, after Linear). accent: the same six accent colours as the rian-app-icon skill, tones = [light, main]; ui_primary is the UI primary each icon accent gives (蓝→蓝, 绿→绿, 紫→紫; warm 珊瑚 and 黄, and 灰, stay in the icon and give 蓝). base: the graphite neutral in CIE LCh (D65), one hue for every surface, chroma per mode (L 100 is plain white). ladder: L of each opaque neutral per mode. text: starting L of the four text tiers per contrast level; build.py only moves them toward more contrast until they pass (high-contrast text takes the end of the range as is). alpha: [base colour, opacity] per mode, where 'elevated' means that mode's elevated colour; menu_active is white over elevated in dark mode (light mode uses surface-3); frost_high replaces the frost opacity in the high-contrast schemes. primary: fill_target is the white-on-fill contrast the fill's L is chosen for, text_target what primary-text reaches on every surface (standard level; high contrast asks 7), selected and selection are the primary's opacity over bg for multi-selected rows and for text selection. status: which accent each status colour comes from.
